+def component_08(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    initial_mask = sum(1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)
+                       if node == data["source"])
+    start_state = (data["source"], initial_mask, data["coupons"])
+    distances = {start_state: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"],) + start_state]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, remaining = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, remaining)
+        if distances.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full and remaining == 0:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            choices = [(edge["duration"], remaining)]
+            if remaining:
+                choices.append((max(2, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0)), remaining - 1))
+            for duration, left in choices:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:

+                nxt = edge["v"]
+                new_mask = mask | sum(1 << i for i, n in enumerate(required) if n == nxt)
